Colors: pelican gray/white body, orange-yellow beak and pouch, orange webbed feet. Bicycle: teal/cream retro. Background: soft sky gradient with sun and clouds maybe. Keep it tasteful.

Let me add nice details: spokes, wheel rims, tire, hub, fender maybe, basket? Maybe a small fish dangling from the basket for charm. That could be fun: a front basket with a fish sticking out. Simplify: draw bicycle fully, then pelican legs (near leg over frame), body, neck/head, wing last.

Hmm the seat: pelican sits on seat, body covers seat. Draw seat before body.
